headline: Fortinet Expands FortiGate G Series with 1200G and FortiSASE Outpost to Advance Firewall and SASE Convergence
summary: FortiGate 1200G with FortiSASE Outpost brings ASIC-powered threat protection and cloud-delivered SASE to customer-controlled environmentsSUNNYVALE, Calif., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fortinet® (NASDAQ: FTNT), the global cybersecurity leader driving the convergence of networking and security, today announced the FortiGate 1200G series, the newest addition to the FortiGate G series with FortiSASE Outpost, which brings cloud-delivered security services into customer-controlled environments.
